description: Add a custom metadata field to the project's metadata schema. This creates a schema/column definition only; it does not set a per-item value. Use set_metadata field_name/value or complete Project Metadata XML with readback to update a value.

field_name.description: Internal name for the metadata field

field_type.description: Type of the field: 0 = Integer, 1 = Real, 2 = String, 3 = Boolean

name: add_custom_metadata_field

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Add Custom Metadata Field
